Privacy, in plain English

Your library is none of our business.

SFX Finder runs entirely on your computer. It creates a small local index so you can search quickly. The website and the app are designed without accounts, telemetry, or remote library processing.

01

Never uploaded

  • Audio files or previews
  • Filenames or folder paths
  • Catalog descriptions
  • Search history or selected clips
02

Stored locally

  • Your searchable index
  • Your library location
  • Your app settings
  • Your copy history
03

Simply not present

  • No analytics
  • No tracking cookies
  • No account or sign-in
  • No background cloud sync
When is the internet used?

Only when you visit this page and download the installer. Once installed, searching and previewing the library does not require an internet connection. Feedback opens your own email app; this site does not receive or relay the message.

Three minutes, once

Point it at the library.
Then get back to the cut.

  1. 1

    Download and open

    Mac: unzip, then Right-click the app and choose Open the first time. Windows: install Python, select Add Python to PATH, then run start.bat.

  2. 2

    Choose the shared library

    Select the folder containing SFX_DB.xls and SFX Libraries. The app reads filenames and the catalog sheet to build a local index.

  3. 3

    Search, preview, collect

    Try natural phrases such as high heel concrete or body hit ground. Tick the sounds you want and copy them into a named project folder.

Installation and removal details

Mac security prompt

The Mac build is not notarized. If macOS says it cannot verify the developer, Right-click SFX Finder.app, choose Open, then confirm. You only need to do this once.

Remove it completely

Delete the app, then delete ~/Library/Application Support/SFX Finder/ to remove its local index and settings. Your sound library and copied project files are not touched.

Important scope

The tool organizes sounds.
It does not license them.

SFX Finder does not contain or distribute any sound-effects library. It only indexes files already available on your computer. You are responsible for having permission to possess and use those files and for following the terms of your project, employer, library vendor, and applicable copyright law.

The software is provided as-is, without warranty. It copies files only after you choose a destination; it does not move, rename, edit, or delete source audio. As with any production tool, keep backups of important project data.
